items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: The interviewer mentions St. Louis Armstrong in the context of the Royal Garden, but the interviewee does not confirm personal interaction, only stating 'She did' regarding his wife Lil playing there, and describing his own later movements.

ctx.x: He didn't buy it. He wrote that, and she sung it at Pete Lalla's Cabaret. Clarence Williams really worked on the number of that.
stuff Then I featured it here on the stage at the Money Graham and Joe Oliver and then there's St. Louis Armstrong and Lil and all of those people at the Royal Garden and that's where we featured it.
You appeared at the Royal Garden too?
